summary: Validated the Expo Go 'Failed to parse manifest JSON' fix. Both iOS and Android manifests served at https://contract-forge-35.preview.emergentagent.com/ now return HTTP 200 with content-type=application/expo+json and parse cleanly as JSON containing id, runtimeVersion=exposdk:54.0.0, launchAsset.url, and extra.expoClient.name='Conexia CLM'. The launchAsset bundle URL returns HTTP 200 with content-type=application/javascript (9.8 MB). Web preview loads the login screen, all required testIDs are present (login-screen, conexia-logo, google-login-button, demo-login-button), and the 'Entrar en modo demo' button completes dev-login and navigates to the dashboard which renders KPI tiles (VALOR TOTAL $20,800,000 / 7 contratos, EJECUTADO $3,260,000, RETENCIONES $1,040,000, MULTAS $47,000) plus the color-coded semaphore (ALTO/MEDIO/BAJO) and the approval pipeline. Backend regression (5 key endpoints: health, dev-login, /auth/me, /dashboard, /contracts) re-ran 5/5 passing — no regression from the previous 18/18 run. No critical issues detected; the bug fix is verified end-to-end.

react_native_issues.issue: Two console warnings on every navigation: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Non-blocking but should be migrated for SDK 54+ compliance. Reference: scan all StyleSheet.create blocks using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius in app/login.tsx and app/(tabs)/*.

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Source likely a third-party component (react-native-reanimated / nav stack overlay). Reference: appears after tapping demo login.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate inline shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence Expo SDK 54 deprecation warnings.
(Optional) Audit usage of the deprecated pointerEvents prop and move it into the style object.
critical_code_review_comments: app.json is correctly minimal: only expo-router + expo-splash-screen plugins. Permission strings remain in ios.infoPlist and android.permissions, which is the right approach for Expo Go (SDK 54 ships expo-camera / expo-image-picker / expo-location / expo-secure-store natively).
Manifest endpoint correctly negotiates content-type via the Expo-Platform header (application/expo+json with header, text/html without).

When the manifest is reached after an http→https redirect with Expo-Platform header preserved, Cloudflare currently returns content-type=text/plain (body is still the valid manifest, 2434 bytes). Expo Go normally connects via exp:// which maps to HTTPS directly, so this should not affect real devices — flagged here for awareness only.

Frontend code in app/evidence/new.tsx still imports expo-image-picker and expo-location; src/api.ts and src/utils/storage/index.ts use expo-secure-store. These work in Expo Go SDK 54 without config plugins, so removing them from app.json plugins is safe.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (manifest iOS+Android, bundle, login render, demo login → dashboard render — all green)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Reused /api/seed (idempotent) and dev-login user demo@conexia.io.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for Expo Go manifest parsing is verified: both iOS and Android manifests at the public URL are valid application/expo+json. Web preview demo-login → dashboard flow works on a 390x844 mobile viewport. Backend is fully green. The only outstanding items are two non-blocking SDK 54 deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents). The single test file /app/backend/tests/test_conexia_clm.py remains the regression entry point.
rca_of_issue: Root cause (per main agent): Expo Go's manifest parser was being served an HTML/text response instead of application/expo+json on some requests, because the previous app.json included plugin entries (expo-secure-store, expo-camera, expo-image-picker, expo-location) that are NOT needed for Expo Go runtime and could affect manifest generation when combined with Cloudflare redirect header stripping. FIX (already applied by main agent): app.json reduced to only expo-router + expo-splash-screen plugins; permission strings preserved in ios.infoPlist / android.permissions. VERIFIED: manifests now return application/expo+json with valid JSON, runtimeVersion=exposdk:54.0.0, and a reachable launchAsset bundle. Repro/validation: `curl -H 'Expo-Platform: ios' https://contract-forge-35.preview.emergentagent.com/` returns the parseable manifest JSON; same for android. No further mitigation required.
